premises.text: Hair and beauty pros lack websites, client tracking, marketing email, online schedules, and business insight, while clients struggle to find stylists in a large offline word-of-mouth industry
premises.evidence_span: She doesn't have a website. She doesn't track client information or send marketing emails

premises.text: StyleSeat gives each professional a website with social Like/Share and the ability to post specials
premises.evidence_span: with StyleSeek, Glenda gets her own website

premises.text: Clients can search local professionals, sort, book online (including last-minute), get reminders, and leave/share recommendations
premises.evidence_span: I can go to styleseat.com, type in haircut San Francisco, get a search results page

premises.text: Pros get schedule access, client CRM, marketing emails, an education center, and inspiration photo streams
premises.evidence_span: Glenda has direct access to her schedule for the first time. She has all her client information in one place

premises.text: Dashboard shows business metrics, revenue goals, page stats, booking load, retail, suggestions, busy/free times, and time-slot monetary values
premises.evidence_span: We also give her a dashboard with an overview. So she has key information about her business

premises.text: Freemium model with free online booking and scheduling makes the platform available to the entire industry
premises.evidence_span: We have freemium model, free online booking, free scheduling, so we're available for the entire industry

premises.text: Large addressable market of beauty/wellness pros and clients open to finding new professionals, now adopting Facebook and smartphones
premises.evidence_span: There's over 2 million Glendas in the US

value.text: Stylists can actively grow their businesses online while clients find and book the right professional
value.evidence_span: the first time, Glenda can actively grow her business

secondary_value.text: Unlock inefficiency by freeing unused marketing capital and redirecting revenue through a more efficient market
secondary_value.evidence_span: StyleSeat will unlock $18 billion in inefficiency in the space

causal_links.evidence_span: the industry isn't online, and so it's hard to find a stylist
we give her the information as well as the things that she can do to grow her business
free online booking, free scheduling, so we're available for the entire industry

notes: Glenda pain list folded as one problem set (§4.1.6); client findability folded into same offline-industry pain. Split website, client booking marketplace, ops/CRM suite, and analytics dashboard as distinct capability jobs. Mobile apps folded into product cascade.
